title: End of Coverage and Policy Expiry, Trip Protection
content:
Trip Protection coverage ends on the stay's check-out date, and the policy expires the next day. A claim for a loss that occurred during coverage may still be submitted within the plan's claim filing period after the loss. An expired policy refunds no premium.

## The clause in parts

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Last day of coverage | The stay's check-out date |
| Policy expiry | The day after the check-out date; the system moves the policy to expired |
| Claim for a loss during coverage | May still be submitted after expiry, within the claim filing period counted from the loss |
| Premium on an expired policy | None is refunded |

## Hypothetical illustration

A stay checks out on 14 August. Coverage runs through 14 August and the policy expires on 15 August. A loss that occurred on 12 August, during coverage, may be claimed after 15 August so long as the claim is submitted within the plan's claim filing period counted from 12 August. No premium is refunded on the policy once it has expired.
